title.zh: 卷二十六 本紀第二十六: 仁宗三
title.raw: 卷二十六 本紀第二十六: 仁宗三 Volume 26 Annals 26: Renzong 3

sentences.zh: 四年春正月庚子，帝謂左右曰：「中書比奏百姓乏食，宜加賑恤。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, on gengzi day the Emperor said to those beside him: "The central secretariat has lately reported that the common people lack food; relief should be increased.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, spring, first month, on gengzi day the Emperor said to those beside him, "The central secretariat has lately reported that the common people lack food; relief should be increased.

sentences.zh: 朕默思之，民饑若此，豈政有過差以致然歟？

translations.literal: We have pondered this in silence: the people hunger so — could there be errors in government that have brought this about?
translations.idiomatic: We have pondered this in silence: the people hunger so — could there be errors in government that have brought this about?

sentences.zh: 向詔百司務遵世祖成憲，宜勉力奉行，輔朕不逮，然嘗思之，唯省刑薄賦，庶使百姓各遂其生也。

translations.literal: We earlier decreed that all offices should earnestly follow Shizu's established institutions; they should strive to carry them out and assist Us where We fall short. Yet We have often reflected that only by reducing punishments and lightening taxes can the common people each pursue their livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: We earlier decreed that all offices should earnestly follow Shizu's established institutions; they should strive to carry them out and assist Us where We fall short. Yet We have often reflected that only by reducing punishments and lightening taxes can the common people each pursue their livelihood.

sentences.zh: 」乙卯，諸王脫脫駐雲南，擾害軍民，以按灰代之。

translations.literal: " On yimao day Prince Toghto was stationed in Yunnan, harassing troops and commoners; Anhui was appointed to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: " On yimao day Prince Toghto was stationed in Yunnan, harassing troops and commoners; Anhui was appointed to replace him.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以知樞密院事完者為雲南行省平章政事。

translations.literal: On bingchen day Vanchu, privy council administrator, was made Yunnan branch secretariat grand councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Vanchu, privy council administrator, was made Yunnan branch secretariat grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 己未，給帝師寺廩食鈔萬錠。

translations.literal: On jiwei day ten thousand ingots of notes were issued as grain stipends for the Imperial Preceptor's temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day 10,000 ingots of notes were issued as grain stipends for the Imperial Preceptor's temple.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，冀寧路地震。

translations.literal: On renxu day Jining Route suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Jining Route suffered an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，給諸王也速也不幹、明安答兒部糧三月。

translations.literal: On wuchen day three months' grain was granted to the followings of Princes Yisubughan and Mingandaa.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day 3 months' grain was granted to the followings of Princes Yisubughan and Mingandaa.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚辰，封諸王孛羅為冀王。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on gengchen day Prince Boluo was enfeoffed as Prince of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, on gengchen day Prince Boluo was enfeoffed as Prince of Ji.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以立皇太子詔天下，給賜鰥寡孤獨鈔，減免各路租稅有差。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, because the crown prince was established, an edict was proclaimed to the realm; notes were granted to widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary; land tax and levies on the various routes were remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, because the crown prince was established, an edict was proclaimed to the realm; notes were granted to widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary; land tax and levies on the various routes were remitted in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王、宗戚朝會者，金三百兩、銀二千五百兩、鈔四萬三千九百錠。

translations.literal: Princes, imperial kin, and those who attended court were granted three hundred taels of gold, two thousand five hundred taels of silver, and forty-three thousand nine hundred ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Princes, imperial kin, and those who attended court were granted 300 taels of gold, 2,500 taels of silver, and 43,900 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，封別鐵木兒為汾陽王。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Betemür was enfeoffed as Prince of Fenyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Betemür was enfeoffed as Prince of Fenyang.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，給豳王南忽裏部鈔十二萬錠買馬。

translations.literal: On renchen day Prince Bin Nanhuli's following was granted one hundred twenty thousand ingots of notes to buy horses.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Prince Bin Nanhuli's following was granted 120,000 ingots of notes to buy horses.

sentences.zh: 汴梁、揚州、河南、淮安、重慶、順慶、襄陽民皆饑，發廩賑之。

translations.literal: The people of Bianliang, Yangzhou, Henan, Huai'an, Chongqing, Shunqing, and Xiangyang all suffered famine; granaries were opened and grain issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Bianliang, Yangzhou, Henan, Huai'an, Chongqing, Shunqing, and Xiangyang all suffered famine; granaries were opened and grain issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 二月庚子，賜諸王買閭部鈔三萬錠。

translations.literal: Second month, on gengzi day Prince Mailu's following was granted thirty thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on gengzi day Prince Mailu's following was granted 30,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，敕郡縣各社復置義倉。

translations.literal: On jiachen day an edict directed every community in each commandery and county to re-establish charity granaries.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict directed every community in each commandery and county to re-establish charity granaries.

sentences.zh: 戊申，特授近侍完者不花翰林侍讀學士、知制誥、同修國史。

translations.literal: On wushen day attendant Wanbu Hua was specially appointed Hanlin Academician Reader, drafter of edicts, and associate compiler of the national history.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day attendant Wanbu Hua was specially appointed Hanlin Academician Reader, drafter of edicts, and associate compiler of the national history.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，升泰寧府為泰寧路，仍置泰寧縣。

translations.literal: On guihai day Taining Prefecture was raised to Taining Route, and Taining County was still established.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Taining Prefecture was raised to Taining Route, and Taining County was still established.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，升蒙古國子監秩正三品，賜銀印。

translations.literal: On yichou day the rank of the Mongol Directorate of Education was raised to primary third grade, and a silver seal was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day the rank of the Mongol Directorate of Education was raised to primary third grade, and a silver seal was granted.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以諸王部值脫火赤之亂，百姓貧乏，給鈔十六萬六千錠、米萬石賑之。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, because princes' followings had suffered the turmoil of the rebel Tuhochi and the common people were impoverished, one hundred sixty-six thousand ingots of notes and ten thousand shi of grain were granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, because princes' followings had suffered the turmoil of the rebel Tuhochi and the common people were impoverished, 166,000 ingots of notes and 10,000 shi of grain were granted for relief.

sentences.zh: 曹州水，免今年租。

translations.literal: Caozhou suffered flooding; this year's land tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Caozhou suffered flooding; this year's land tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯朔，升靖州為路。

translations.literal: Third month, on dingmao new moon, Jing Prefecture was raised to Jing Route.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on dingmao new moon, Jing Prefecture was raised to Jing Route.

sentences.zh: 庚午，給趙王阿魯禿部糧四千石。

translations.literal: On gengwu day four thousand shi of grain were granted to Prince of Zhao Arghun's following.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day 4,000 shi of grain were granted to Prince of Zhao Arghun's following.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，太陰犯箕。

translations.literal: On yiyou day the moon transgressed Winnowing Basket.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the moon transgressed Winnowing Basket.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On xinmao day the imperial carriage visited the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the imperial carriage visited the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌，給安王兀都思不花部軍糧三月。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on wuxu day three months' military grain was granted to Prince of An Udsibuyah's following.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on wuxu day 3 months' military grain was granted to Prince of An Udsibuyah's following.

sentences.zh: 己亥，德安府旱，免屯田租。

translations.literal: On jihai day Dean Prefecture suffered drought; garrison-farm land tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Dean Prefecture suffered drought; garrison-farm land tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，加授太常禮儀院使拜住大司徒，賜趙王阿魯禿金五十兩、銀五百兩、鈔千錠，割懷來縣隸龍慶州。

translations.literal: On renyin day Commissioner of the Grand Ceremonies Bureau Xiao Baizhu was additionally appointed Grand Tutor; Prince of Zhao Arghun was granted fifty taels of gold, five hundred taels of silver, and one thousand ingots of notes; Huailai County was detached and placed under Longqing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day commissioner of the Grand Ceremonies Bureau Xiao Baizhu was additionally appointed grand tutor; Prince of Zhao Arghun was granted 50 taels of gold, 500 taels of silver, and 1,000 ingots of notes; Huailai County was detached and placed under Longqing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以太寧路隸遼陽省。

translations.literal: On jiachen day Taining Route was placed under Liaoyang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Taining Route was placed under Liaoyang Province.

sentences.zh: 戊申，答合孫寇邊，吳王朵列納等敗之於和懷，賜金玉束帶、黃金、幣帛有差。

translations.literal: On wushen day Dengzhong raided the frontier; Prince Wu Duoliena and others defeated him at Hehuai; gold and jade belts, gold, and silks and cloths were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Dengzhong raided the frontier; Prince Wu Duoliena and others defeated him at Hehuai; gold and jade belts, gold, and silks and cloths were granted in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 己未，諸王紐憐薨。

translations.literal: On jiwei day Prince Niulian died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Prince Niulian died.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，禁嶺北酒。

translations.literal: On yichou day wine was forbidden in Lingbei.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day wine was forbidden in Lingbei.

sentences.zh: 常嘗夜坐，謂侍臣曰：「雨旸不時，奈何？

translations.literal: Once when the Emperor was sitting at night, he said to attending ministers: "Rain and drought are untimely — what is to be done?
translations.idiomatic: Once when the Emperor was sitting at night, he said to attending ministers, "Rain and drought are untimely — what is to be done?

sentences.zh: 」蕭拜住對曰：「宰相之過也。

translations.literal: " Xiao Baizhu replied: "This is the fault of the chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: " Xiao Baizhu replied, "This is the fault of the chancellor.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「卿不在中書耶？

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "Are you not in the central secretariat?
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "Are you not in the central secretariat?

sentences.zh: 」拜住惶愧。

translations.literal: " Xiao Baizhu was ashamed and remorseful.
translations.idiomatic: " Xiao Baizhu was ashamed and remorseful.

sentences.zh: 頃之，帝露香默禱。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward, the Emperor exposed incense and prayed in silence.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward, the Emperor exposed incense and prayed in silence.

sentences.zh: 既而大雨，左右以雨衣進，帝曰：「朕為民祈雨，何避焉！

translations.literal: Soon heavy rain fell; attendants brought rain garments forward; the Emperor said: "We pray for rain for the people — why avoid it!
translations.idiomatic: Soon heavy rain fell; attendants brought rain garments forward; the Emperor said, "We pray for rain for the people — why avoid it!

sentences.zh: 」翰林學士承旨忽都魯都兒迷失、劉賡等譯《大學衍義》以進，帝覽之，謂群臣曰：「《大學衍義》議論甚嘉，其令翰林學士阿憐鐵木兒譯以國語。

translations.literal: " Hanlin Academician Exemplar Qutlughdushmish and Liu Geng and others translated the 《Great Learning Extended Meaning》 and presented it; the Emperor read it and said to the assembled ministers: "The discussions in the 《Great Learning Extended Meaning》 are very fine; order Hanlin Academician Alintemür to translate it into the national language.
translations.idiomatic: " Hanlin Academician Exemplar Qutlughdushmish and Liu Geng and others translated the 《Great Learning Extended Meaning》 and presented it; the Emperor read it and said to the assembled ministers, "The discussions in the 《Great Learning Extended Meaning》 are very fine; order Hanlin Academician Alintemür to translate it into the national language.

sentences.zh: 」五月辛未，授上都留守闊闊出開府儀同三司、大司徒。

translations.literal: " Fifth month, on xinwei day Shangdu resident commissioner Kuokuo was granted Commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies and Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: " Fifth month, on xinwei day Shangdu resident commissioner Kuokuo was granted commissioner with the ceremonial standing equal to the Three Excellencies and grand tutor.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賜出征諸王醜漢等金銀、鈔幣有差。

translations.literal: On renshen day princes on campaign including Chouhan were granted graded amounts of gold, silver, and notes.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day princes on campaign including Chouhan were granted graded amounts of gold, silver, and notes.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，加封大長公主忙哥臺為皇姑大長公主，給金印。

translations.literal: On yihai day Grand Eldest Princess Manggotai was further enfeoffed as Imperial Aunt Grand Eldest Princess, and a gold seal was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Grand Eldest Princess Manggotai was further enfeoffed as Imperial Aunt Grand Eldest Princess, and a gold seal was granted.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，改衛率府為中翊府。

translations.literal: On wuyin day the Guard Rate Office was changed to the Zhongyi Office.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Guard Rate Office was changed to the Zhongyi Office.

sentences.zh: 壬午，黃州、高郵、真州、建寧等處，流民群聚，持兵抄掠，敕所在有司，其傷人及盜者罪之，余並給糧遣歸。

translations.literal: On renwu day at Huangzhou, Gaoyou, Zhenzhou, Jianning, and other places, refugees gathered in groups, bearing arms and plundering; an edict directed the local offices that those who injured people and thieves should be punished, while the remainder should all be given grain and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day at Huangzhou, Gaoyou, Zhenzhou, Jianning, and other places, refugees gathered in groups, bearing arms and plundering; an edict directed the local offices that those who injured people and thieves should be punished, while the remainder should all be given grain and sent home.

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士承旨赤因鐵木兒為中書平章政事，中書平章兀伯都剌為集賢大學士。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Exemplar Chigin Temür was made central secretariat grand councillor; central secretariat grand councillor Wuberdula was made grand academician of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician Exemplar Chigin Temür was made central secretariat grand councillor; central secretariat grand councillor Wuberdula was made grand academician of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies.

sentences.zh: 己丑，升中書左丞阿卜海牙為平章政事，參政乞塔為右丞，高昉為左丞，參議中書省事換住、張思明並參知政事。

translations.literal: On jichou day central secretariat left vice chancellor Abuhaiya was promoted to grand councillor; associate administrator Qita was made right vice chancellor, Gao Fang left vice chancellor; deliberators on central secretariat affairs Huanzhu and Zhang Siming were both made associate administrators.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day central secretariat left vice chancellor Abuhaiya was promoted to grand councillor; associate administrator Qita was made right vice chancellor, Gao Fang left vice chancellor; deliberators on central secretariat affairs Huanzhu and Zhang Siming were both made associate administrators.

sentences.zh: 六月乙巳，太陰犯心。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on yisi day the moon transgressed Heart.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on yisi day the moon transgressed Heart.

sentences.zh: 內外監察御史四十餘人劾鐵木叠兒奸貪不法。

translations.literal: More than forty surveillance censors inside and outside the court impeached Temüder for wickedness, corruption, and unlawful conduct.
translations.idiomatic: More than 40 surveillance censors inside and outside the court impeached Temüder for wickedness, corruption, and unlawful conduct.

sentences.zh: 戊申，鐵木叠兒罷，以左丞相合散為中書右丞相。

translations.literal: On wushen day Temüder was dismissed; left chancellor Hesan was made right chancellor of the central secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Temüder was dismissed; left chancellor Hesan was made right chancellor of the central secretariat.

sentences.zh: 己酉，兀伯都剌復為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: On jiyou day Wuberdula was again made central secretariat grand councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Wuberdula was again made central secretariat grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以工部尚書王桂為中書參知政事。

translations.literal: On renzi day Minister of Works Wang Gui was made central secretariat associate administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day minister of works Wang Gui was made central secretariat associate administrator.

sentences.zh: 安遠王醜漢、趙王阿魯禿為叛王脫火赤所掠，各賜金銀、幣帛。

translations.literal: Princes of Anyuan Chouhan and Zhao Arghun had been plundered by the rebel Tuhochi; each was granted gold, silver, and silks and cloths.
translations.idiomatic: Princes of Anyuan Chouhan and Zhao Arghun had been plundered by the rebel Tuhochi; each was granted gold, silver, and silks and cloths.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，敕：「諸王、駙馬、功臣分地，仍舊制自辟達魯花赤。

translations.literal: On bingchen day an edict directed: "For apportioned fiefs of princes, imperial sons-in-law, and meritorious subjects, the former system of appointing darughachi at their own discretion still applies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict directed, "For apportioned fiefs of princes, imperial sons-in-law, and meritorious subjects, the former system of appointing darughachi at their own discretion still applies.

sentences.zh: 」丁巳，安南國遣使來貢。

translations.literal: " On disi day the Kingdom of Annam dispatched envoys to enter tribute.
translations.idiomatic: " On disi day the Kingdom of Annam dispatched envoys to enter tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊午，置冀王孛羅王傅二員，中尉、司馬各一員，都總管府秩正三品。

translations.literal: On wuwu day two princely tutors were established for Prince of Ji Boluo; one each of commander-in-chief and marshal; the Overall Directorate rank primary third grade.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day 2 princely tutors were established for Prince of Ji Boluo; 1 each of commander-in-chief and marshal; the Overall Directorate rank primary third grade.

sentences.zh: 己未，給嶺北行省經費鈔九十萬錠、雜彩五萬匹。

translations.literal: On jiwei day nine hundred thousand ingots of notes and fifty thousand bolts of miscellaneous silks were granted for the Lingbei branch secretariat operating expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day 900,000 ingots of notes and 50,000 bolts of miscellaneous silks were granted for the Lingbei branch secretariat operating expenses.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，禁總攝沈明仁所佩司空印毋移文有司。

translations.literal: On guihai day it was forbidden for the White Cloud sect patriarch Shen Mingren, wearing the Grand Guardian seal, to issue documents to government offices.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day it was forbidden for the White Cloud sect patriarch Shen Mingren, wearing the Grand Guardian seal, to issue documents to government offices.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙亥，李孟罷，以江浙行省左丞王毅為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on yihai day Li Meng was dismissed; Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat left vice chancellor Wang Yi was made central secretariat grand councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on yihai day Li Meng was dismissed; Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat left vice chancellor Wang Yi was made central secretariat grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，賜皇姑大長公主忙哥臺金百兩、銀千兩、鈔二千錠、幣帛各百匹。

translations.literal: On gengchen day Imperial Aunt Grand Eldest Princess Manggotai was granted one hundred taels of gold, one thousand taels of silver, two thousand ingots of notes, and one hundred bolts each of silks and cloths.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Imperial Aunt Grand Eldest Princess Manggotai was granted 100 taels of gold, 1,000 taels of silver, 2,000 ingots of notes, and 100 bolts each of silks and cloths.

sentences.zh: 賞討叛王有功句容郡王床兀兒等金銀、幣帛、鈔各有差。

translations.literal: Jurong Commandery Prince Chuangwu'er and others who had merit in suppressing the rebel prince were granted graded amounts of gold, silver, silks and cloths, and notes.
translations.idiomatic: Jurong Commandery Prince Chuangwu'er and others who had merit in suppressing the rebel prince were granted graded amounts of gold, silver, silks and cloths, and notes.

sentences.zh: 壬午，敕赤因鐵木兒頒賚諸王、駙馬，及賑濟所部貧乏。

translations.literal: On renwu day an edict directed Chigin Temür to distribute rewards to princes and imperial sons-in-law, and to relieve impoverishment in their followings.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict directed Chigin Temür to distribute rewards to princes and imperial sons-in-law, and to relieve impoverishment in their followings.

sentences.zh: 特授中衛親軍都指揮使孛蘭奚太尉。

translations.literal: Central Guard personal army commander Bolanxi was specially appointed Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: Central Guard personal army commander Bolanxi was specially appointed grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 己丑，成紀縣山崩，土石潰徙，壞田稼廬舍，壓死居民。

translations.literal: On jichou day Chenji County suffered a mountain collapse; earth and stones slid away, destroying fields and dwellings, crushing residents to death.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Chenji County suffered a mountain collapse; earth and stones slid away, destroying fields and dwellings, crushing residents to death.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，冀寧路地震。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Jining Route suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Jining Route suffered an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 帝諭省臣曰：「比聞蒙古諸部困乏，往往鬻子女於民家為婢仆，其命有司贖之還各部。

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed secretariat officials: "We have lately heard that Mongol followings are distressed and often sell sons and daughters to commoner households as slaves and servants; order the offices to redeem them and return them to their respective followings.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor instructed secretariat officials, "We have lately heard that Mongol followings are distressed and often sell sons and daughters to commoner households as slaves and servants; order the offices to redeem them and return them to their respective followings.

sentences.zh: 」帝出，見衛士有敝衣者，駐馬問之，對曰：「戍守邊鎮余十五年，以故貧耳。

translations.literal: " When the Emperor went out, he saw a guard in worn clothing; he reined in his horse and asked him; the man replied: "I have garrisoned a frontier fortress for more than fifteen years — that is why I am poor.
translations.idiomatic: " When the Emperor went out, he saw a guard in worn clothing; he reined in his horse and asked him; the man replied, "I have garrisoned a frontier fortress for more than 15 years — that is why I am poor.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「此輩久勞於外，留守臣未常以聞，非朕親見，何由知之！

translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "You need not speak thus; each of you should jointly attend to your duties.

sentences.zh: 」癸未，帝御大明殿，受諸王、百官朝賀。

translations.literal: " On guiwei day the Emperor took Great Brightness Hall and received the court congratulations of princes and all officials.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day the Emperor took Great Brightness Hall and received the court congratulations of princes and all officials.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，江浙行省丞相黑驢言：「白雲僧沈明仁，擅度僧四千八百餘人，獲鈔四萬餘錠，既已辭伏，今遣其徒沈崇勝潛赴京師行賄求援，請逮赴江浙，並治其罪。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat chancellor Heilü said, "The White Cloud monk Shen Mingren on his own authority ordained more than four thousand eight hundred monks, obtaining more than forty thousand ingots; having already confessed, he now sends his disciple Shen Chongsheng secretly to the capital to bribe and seek rescue; We request he be arrested and sent to Jiang-Zhe and punished together with his offense.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat chancellor Heilü said, "The White Cloud monk Shen Mingren on his own authority ordained more than 4,800 monks, obtaining more than 40,000 ingots; having already confessed, he now sends his disciple Shen Chongsheng secretly to the capital to bribe and seek rescue; We request he be arrested and sent to Jiang-Zhe and punished together with his offense.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: It was approved.

sentences.zh: 乙未，太陰犯明堂上星。

translations.literal: On yiwei day the moon transgressed the upper star of Mingtang.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the moon transgressed the upper star of Mingtang.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，帝不豫。

translations.literal: On dinghai day the Emperor fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Emperor fell ill.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，帝崩於光天宮，壽三十有六，在位十年。

translations.literal: On xinchou day the Emperor died at Guangtian Palace; he was thirty-six years old and had reigned ten years.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the Emperor died at Guangtian Palace; he was 36 years old and had reigned 10 years.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，葬起輦谷，從諸帝陵。

translations.literal: On guimao day he was buried at Qinian Valley, following the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day he was buried at Qinian Valley, following the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，群臣上謚曰聖文欽孝皇帝，廟號仁宗，國語曰普顏篤皇帝。

translations.literal: Fifth month, yiwei day: the assembled officials presented the posthumous title Shengwen Qinxiao Emperor; temple name Renzong; in the national language Buyan Du Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, yiwei day: the assembled officials presented the posthumous title Shengwen Qinxiao Emperor; temple name Renzong; in the national language Buyan Du Emperor.

sentences.zh: 仁宗天性慈孝，聰明恭儉，通達儒術，妙悟釋典，嘗曰：「明心見性，佛教為深；

translations.literal: Renzong was by nature filial and benevolent, intelligent, respectful, and frugal; he mastered Confucian learning and deeply comprehended Buddhist scriptures; he once said, "To clarify the mind and see one's nature, Buddhism goes deeper;
translations.idiomatic: Renzong was by nature filial and benevolent, intelligent, respectful, and frugal; he mastered Confucian learning and deeply comprehended Buddhist scriptures; he once said, "To clarify the mind and see one's nature, Buddhism goes deeper;

sentences.zh: 修身治國，儒道為切。

translations.literal: to cultivate the person and govern the state, the Confucian Way is more urgent.
translations.idiomatic: to cultivate the person and govern the state, the Confucian Way is more urgent.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「儒者可尚，以能維持三綱五常之道也。

translations.literal: " He also said, "Confucian scholars deserve esteem, for they can uphold the Way of the Three Bonds and Five Constant Virtues.
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "Confucian scholars deserve esteem, for they can uphold the Way of the Three Bonds and Five Constant Virtues.

sentences.zh: 」平居服御質素，淡然無欲，不事遊畋，不喜征伐，不崇貨利。

translations.literal: " In daily life his dress and equipage were plain; he was detached and without desire; he did not engage in hunting excursions, did not delight in military campaigns, and did not exalt profit and goods.
translations.idiomatic: In daily life his dress and equipage were plain; he was detached and without desire; he did not engage in hunting excursions, did not delight in military campaigns, and did not exalt profit and goods.

sentences.zh: 事皇太后，終身不違顏色；

translations.literal: In serving the empress dowager, he never went against her countenance throughout his life;
translations.idiomatic: In serving the empress dowager, he never went against her countenance throughout his life;

sentences.zh: 待宗戚勛舊，始終以禮。

translations.literal: in treating imperial kin and meritorious elders, he always observed rites from beginning to end.
translations.idiomatic: in treating imperial kin and meritorious elders, he always observed rites from beginning to end.

sentences.zh: 大臣親老，時加恩賚；

translations.literal: When ministers had aged parents, he would timely add marks of favor;
translations.idiomatic: When ministers had aged parents, he would timely add marks of favor;

sentences.zh: 太官進膳，必分賜貴近。

translations.literal: when the Imperial Kitchen presented meals, he always divided and bestowed them on the honored and those near at hand.
translations.idiomatic: when the Imperial Kitchen presented meals, he always divided and bestowed them on the honored and those near at hand.

sentences.zh: 有司奏大辟，每慘惻移時。

translations.literal: When officials reported capital punishment cases, he would always grow deeply sorrowful for a long while.
translations.idiomatic: When officials reported capital punishment cases, he would always grow deeply sorrowful for a long while.

sentences.zh: 其孜孜為治，一遵世祖之成憲云。

translations.literal: Thus in his tireless governance, he wholly followed Shizu's established institutions.
translations.idiomatic: Thus in his tireless governance, he wholly followed Shizu's established institutions.
